summary: Research department-wide recruitment (flows A–E) validation. Backend: all 20 pytest tests in test_research_recruitment.py + test_research_access.py + test_research_phase2.py + test_research_module.py PASS (20/20). Frontend A fully verified: as Atharva (PI), /research/6ad0faf4475991e08e4cde03/screening shows dept-banner (dept-recruitment copy), 16 treating-* rows with 'Treated by Dr. Gaurav Pandey · Dr. Paresh Gandhi …', the tooth-24/procedure 6a6b300e811c1535451fde6a row shows req-status-* text 'Inclusion requested — awaiting the treating clinician's consent confirmation' and NO Request button (query returned None), and another eligible row request-6ab4bb620dc6e3397a201fa6-16 opens the 'Request inclusion' sheet with request-message field → 'Send request' → row flips to pending status; /research/<id>/ethics shows recruitment-scope-card 'Department-wide' selected and the iec-multi-operator checkbox text present. Frontend B fully verified: as Gaurav, /research shows inclusion-strip with text '2 case inclusion requests for you to answer — Dr. Atharva Mahadik asks to include Assistant Flow Patient (tooth 16) in ISQ-DEPT / … UI Aug Patient (tooth 24) in ISQ-DEPT' and inclusion-row-6ad0faf4475991e08e4cde07 + inclusion-row-6ad0fc55475991e08e4cde4e both present. Tapping the first opens the inclusion screen (inclusion-title, inclusion-status 'pending', respond-card visible). Ticking tick-0 + consent-tick, then confirm-accept, included the case (post-flow /research shows ISQ-DEPT card with 'My cases only' chip, '1/40 enrolled', '1 overdue', and open ISQ-DEPT → collaborator-banner visible, overview DOES NOT contain 'Data queries', 'Audit trail', 'Results & export' or 'Synopsis' strings; Cases tab lists enrolment-ISQ-DEPT-P001-I01 'UI Aug Patient · Tooth 24'; opening it loads the Placement visit form showing ISQ bucco-lingual/mesio-distal number inputs). Access to /research/<id>/screening as Gaurav resolves (no crash) but shows no error alert captured via window.dialog — see note below. Frontend C fully verified: tapping inclusion-row-6ad0fc55475991e08e4cde4e → start-decline → confirm-decline with empty reason silently blocked, then decline-reason filled → confirm-decline → row removed from strip; as Atharva /screening shows row with red req-status 'Inclusion declined by treating clinician: Patient not interested in research participation' and 'Request again' button (data-testid request-6ab4bb620dc6e3397a201fa6-16, label 'Request again'). Frontend E partially verified from screenshot: Alerts bottom-tab page displays two research_inclusion notifications with paper-plane icons and inclusion copy ('Dr. Atharva Mahadik requests to include your patient's implant (tooth 16/24) in research study ISQ-DEPT — please accept or decline'). Frontend D (Offer flow) not scripted end-to-end — see 'retest_needed' notes. web Alert.alert() does NOT fire window.alert in this build, so error-alert text could not be captured by Playwright dialog hook; functional outcome of each action (status transitions, redirects, DOM text) WAS verified independently.

ui_bugs.issue: ISQ bucco-lingual / mesio-distal <input> elements render with placeholder '0 – 100 ISQ' but are NOT editable (Playwright element.fill → 'element is not editable'). The visit window is already past ('Placement · Missed · window 2026-07-30 → 2026-08-02') so this may be an intentional lock on missed visits; however the fields still show the red '*' required marker — confusing to a case collaborator who was told in the dept-banner that 'you will be able to enter the study's visit data for this case'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/research/enrolment/[eid].tsx

issues: Research 'User guide' auto-opens on first visit after login even though localStorage research_guide_seen_<uid> is set per the hint in the review request — the uid in the token payload uses a different key format than the one the frontend persists, so pre-seeding the key externally does not suppress it. Hitting browser back resolves it; functionally harmless.

action_items: D (Offer flow) still needs an end-to-end UI check: open one of Gaurav's own cases via the My Cases bottom tab (bottom-nav button, not /my-cases URL — that route is unmatched), locate case-research-card and the case-offer-ISQ-DEPT row, trigger offer-tick-0 + offer-consent-tick + confirm-offer and verify the inclusion request appears in Atharva's strip and in Cases without patient name. Code is wired (CaseResearchCard.tsx testIDs confirmed) so this is a quick re-check once the correct in-app navigation is used.

E (notification tap-navigation) — the Alerts tab correctly renders research_inclusion items with paper-plane icons (verified in /tmp/E_alerts.png); scripted tap-and-navigate to /research/inclusion/<id> was not completed because /alerts is not a direct URL (bottom-tab only). Please re-verify via the bottom-tab Alerts button in a quick manual check.

Consider either (a) hiding the 'ISQ *' required markers on a Missed visit or (b) allowing late data entry — current UX shows an uneditable required field on the only enrolment a case collaborator can see.

Alert.alert() errors (e.g. 'Research consent must be confirmed…', 'Case included', 'Decline reason required') render as a React-Native-Web modal, not window.alert — add testID='alert-dialog' + 'alert-ok' on the custom Alert so future Playwright runs can capture their text.
critical_code_review_comments: research/inclusion/[rid].tsx 'confirm-accept' is kept clickable while clinical-checklist ticks and consent-tick are unchecked — the backend correctly rejects (400 'Research consent must be confirmed…') but the UI could gate the button + inline the hint for a tighter mobile flow.

success_rate.frontend: A 100% · B 100% · C 100% · D ~60% (code wired, offer path not scripted end-to-end) · E ~80% (notification rendering verified; tap-nav not scripted)

seed_data_creation: Flow A created one additional pending inclusion request on procedure 6ab4bb620dc6e3397a201fa6 tooth 16 (ISQ-DEPT) from PI Atharva to treating Gaurav. Flow B accepted request 6ad0faf4475991e08e4cde07 → enrolment ISQ-DEPT-P001-I01 (subject 'UI Aug Patient', tooth 24). Flow C declined request 6ad0fc55475991e08e4cde4e with reason 'Patient not interested in research participation' (row now shows red declined status + 'Request again' in Atharva's screening). ISQ-DEPT study now has 1 enrolment and 1 declined inclusion request. The study, pending inclusion request on tooth 24, and the two seeded users were NOT deleted/archived. Study CBL-IMM-MXA was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Study ISQ-DEPT (6ad0faf4475991e08e4cde03) now has: 1 enrolment ISQ-DEPT-P001-I01 (enrolment id 6ad0fcd3475991e08e4cde55, UI Aug Patient, tooth 24, Gaurav+Paresh as collaborators); 1 declined inclusion request on procedure 6ab4bb620dc6e3397a201fa6 tooth 16 (visible as 'Request again' button in Atharva's screening). The declined-with-reason row and the enrolment persistence make this study a good fixture for retesting the request-again loop and for the Offer flow (D) — any of Gaurav's other eligible procedures that are NOT the two already-touched ones can be used as the Offer source via the My Cases bottom-nav route. React-Native-Web Alert.alert does NOT fire window.alert, so Playwright page.on('dialog') captured zero events; validate alert copy via DOM text (e.g. look for 'Case included' / 'Request sent' modal content) instead. The research guide v1.1 auto-opens on first /research visit for a logged-in user — use page.go_back() after the first nav to clear it (seeding localStorage key 'research_guide_seen_<uid>' from a decoded JWT didn't match whatever key the app uses).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all critical dept-wide recruitment behaviours (dept-banner, de-identified rows, request/accept/decline round-trip, collaborator banner, 'My cases only' chip, hidden PI-only overview rows, screening 403 for non-members, declined-with-reason + 'Request again') are working. Remaining items are test-automation ergonomics (window.alert hook, correct URLs for Offer/Alerts) rather than product defects.
